name: VIX-spike + credit-spread blowout capitulation reversion — buy the forced-deleverage crypto flush (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: post-ETF crypto trades as high-beta risk collateral; a VIX spike + credit-spread blowout triggers cross-asset VaR deleveraging and crypto — the most liquid 24/7 collateral — is sold FIRST and OVERSHOOTS on leveraged-long liquidation cascades. The counterparty is risk-parity/CTA/margin desks that are PRICE-INSENSITIVE forced sellers dumping into a thin book. Edge: fade the forced-seller overshoot after the panic peaks. Enter long when vix_level is in an extreme-high band AND credit_spread is wide (market-wide macro gate) AND crypto is washed out (bb_z deeply negative). A 'someone HAS to sell' liquidity premium, not a forecast. DISCONFIRMER: vix_level and credit_spread are FRED daily with next-day availability — a 4h bar cannot react intraday to a same-day spike (macro read is stale until next day). Kill if entries fire only AFTER the crypto low is in (test T+1-lagged VIX vs the actual bottom), or if a plain oversold bb_z reversion captures the same edge WITHOUT the macro gate.
catalyst: macro panic peak (high VIX + wide credit) into a washed-out crypto tape
